code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, leukopenia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild elevation of inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH). There is also monocytosis and basophilia. The low total CO₂ may indicate metabolic acidosis. These findings suggest a possible acute inflammatory or infectious process, with bone marrow suppression or peripheral destruction. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended, especially given the low oxygen saturation and cytopenias.
